 Main Street Square welcomes back holiday favorites on November 28 
 The celebration will feature a winter market from 1-5 p.m., ice skating from noon to 8 p.m., and the lighting of Rapid City’s official Christmas tree at 5 p.m 
 The early evening news on KOTA Territory TV. By Karli West Published : Nov. 14, 2026 at 11:30 AM CST | Updated : 6 hours ago Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google RAPID CITY, S.D. (KOTA) - A pair of beloved holiday traditions are returning to Main Street Square, bringing the city’s official Christmas tree and outdoor ice skating rink back to the iconic downtown gathering place. 
 The ice rink will still take some time before it’s ready to welcome skaters for the season. The city is also turning to the community for help naming this year’s Christmas tree. 
 Opening day on November 28 will consist of a winter market from 1-5 PM, the ice rink from noon to 8 PM, and a tree lighting ceremony at 5 PM.
 Watch the video for the full report and details on the holiday season’s return to Main Street Square.
